title: simply-atlassian work item config
description: Defines a project's work item: one Jira issue, field by field, and an optional linked Confluence page. Checked into the repository as .simply/atlassian.json. See design 0020. Never put credentials here; they stay in the environment.

guidance.description: Project-wide direction for the agent. Returned by jira_work_get, never sent to Jira or Confluence.

project.description: Project key new issues are created in.

issueType.description: Issue type for new issues, for example Story.

fields.description: Every field a work item has. Fields not listed are neither read nor written. Must include the summary field.

space.description: Space key new pages are created in.

parent.description: Page id new pages are created under.

title.description: Title pattern for new pages. {issue.key} and {issue.<field name>} are substituted.

labels.description: Labels added to every page this tool creates or updates.

when.description: The project's rule for when a work item warrants a page. Returned to the agent; the server never decides this.

sections.description: The page's sections, as guidance. Required headings must exist for a save to succeed.

name.description: The label the agent reads and writes against.

key.description: The Jira field id: summary, description, components, customfield_10045…

type.description: How the value is encoded for each deployment.

description.description: What belongs in the field, as instructions to the agent.

required.description: A save that leaves this field empty is refused.

value.description: With always: true, the value the server always applies.

always.description: Always apply value; the agent cannot change or remove it.

default.description: Applied on create when the agent omits the field. Cannot be combined with always.

allowed.description: For option, options, components, versions and labels: the only values the agent may use.

description.description: What belongs in the section, as instructions to the agent.

required.description: A page save without this heading is refused.
